source.title: Two-parameter discontinuity-induced bifurcations of limit cycles: classification and open problems

needs_review.question_text_raw: Many avenues for future research are opened.

evidence.page: Abstract block on University of Bristol publication page
evidence.quote: Examples of each kind of bifurcation are presented, mostly derived from mechanical applications. For each example, where possible, principal bifurcation curves characteristic to the codimension-two scenario are presented and general features of the dynamics discussed. Many avenues for future research are opened.
